name: Gemini Robotics ER 1.6 Preview
description: Embodied reasoning model that understands physical spaces and plans multi-step tasks for robotic agents, with instrument reading and improved spatial and physical reasoning. Shut down on August 31, 2026; the replacement is Gemini Robotics ER 2.
